INSERT INTO monitoring_runs (scheduled_at,completed_at,status,duration_ms,checked,sent,skipped,failed)
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(scheduled_at) DO UPDATE SET
    completed_at=excluded.completed_at,status=excluded.status,duration_ms=excluded.duration_ms,
    checked=excluded.checked,sent=excluded.sent,skipped=excluded.skipped,failed=excluded.failed
    WHERE excluded.completed_at>=completed_at

INSERT INTO monitoring_state (name,payload,updated_at) VALUES ('cron',?,?)
        ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET payload=excluded.payload,updated_at=excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO service_rate_limits (bucket_key, count, reset_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(bucket_key) DO UPDATE SET
          count = CASE
            WHEN service_rate_limits.reset_at <= ? THEN excluded.count
            ELSE service_rate_limits.count + excluded.count
          END,
          reset_at = CASE
            WHEN service_rate_limits.reset_at <= ? THEN excluded.reset_at
            ELSE service_rate_limits.reset_at
          END
        WHERE service_rate_limits.reset_at <= ?
           OR service_rate_limits.count + excluded.count <= ?
        RETURNING count, reset_at

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
    COALESCE(SUM(status='accepted'),0) AS accepted,COALESCE(SUM(status='failed'),0) AS failed,
    COALESCE(SUM(status='blocked'),0) AS blocked,COALESCE(SUM(status='debug'),0) AS debug,
    COALESCE(SUM(purpose='login'),0) AS login,COALESCE(SUM(purpose='delete-account'),0) AS deletion,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status!='blocked' THEN duration_ms END)) AS averageMs,
    COALESCE(SUM(delivery_status='delivered'),0) AS delivered,
    COALESCE(SUM(delivery_status='delivery_delayed'),0) AS delayed,
    COALESCE(SUM(delivery_status IN ('bounced','failed','suppressed')),0) AS undelivered,
    COALESCE(SUM(delivery_status='complained'),0) AS complained,
    COALESCE(SUM(status='accepted' AND (delivery_status IS NULL OR delivery_status='sent')),0) AS awaitingDelivery
    FROM monitoring_email_delivery WHERE created_at>=? AND created_at<=?

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_snapshots s WHERE s.alert_monitoring_started_at IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guardian_links g WHERE g.owner_user_id=s.user_id
      AND g.status='accepted' AND g.enabled=1 AND EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM push_devices d WHERE d.user_id=g.guardian_user_id))) AS eligible,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_snapshots WHERE updated_at < ?) AS stale,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guardian_links WHERE status='accepted' AND enabled=1) AS guardians,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guardian_links WHERE status='pending') AS invitations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM push_devices WHERE platform='android') AS android,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM push_devices WHERE platform='ios') AS ios,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guardian_alerts WHERE created_at>=? AND status='sent') AS accepted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guardian_alerts WHERE created_at>=? AND status='pending') AS pending,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guardian_alerts WHERE created_at>=? AND status='failed' AND attempt_count<?) AS retrying,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guardian_alerts WHERE created_at>=? AND status='failed' AND attempt_count>=?) AS exhausted,
  (SELECT MIN(s.next_alert_check_at) FROM sync_snapshots s WHERE s.next_alert_check_at<=?
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guardian_links g WHERE g.owner_user_id=s.user_id
      AND g.status='accepted' AND g.enabled=1 AND EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM push_devices d WHERE d.user_id=g.guardian_user_id))) AS oldest_due

INSERT INTO monitoring_metrics
  (bucket,metric,dimension,count,failures,client_errors,duration_sum,l250,l500,l1000,l3000,lover)
  VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(bucket,metric,dimension) DO UPDATE SET
  count=count+excluded.count, failures=failures+excluded.failures,
  client_errors=client_errors+excluded.client_errors,
  duration_sum=duration_sum+excluded.duration_sum,
  l250=l250+excluded.l250, l500=l500+excluded.l500, l1000=l1000+excluded.l1000,
  l3000=l3000+excluded.l3000, lover=lover+excluded.lover

INSERT INTO monitoring_failures (bucket,source,code,path,method,status,first_at,last_at,count,duration_max,version)
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(bucket,source,code,path,method,status) DO UPDATE SET
    first_at=MIN(first_at,excluded.first_at),last_at=MAX(last_at,excluded.last_at),count=count+excluded.count,
    duration_max=MAX(duration_max,excluded.duration_max),version=CASE WHEN excluded.last_at>=last_at THEN excluded.version ELSE version END

INSERT INTO sync_snapshots
          (user_id, revision, encryption_key_id, encrypted, nonce, auth_tag, updated_at,
           alert_monitoring_started_at, next_alert_check_at)
        SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
        WHERE ? = 0 OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM sync_snapshots WHERE user_id = ? AND revision = ?
        )
        ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET
          revision = excluded.revision,
          encryption_key_id = excluded.encryption_key_id,
          encrypted = excluded.encrypted,
          nonce = excluded.nonce,
          auth_tag = excluded.auth_tag,
          updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
          alert_monitoring_started_at = CASE
            WHEN excluded.alert_monitoring_started_at IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(sync_snapshots.alert_monitoring_started_at, excluded.alert_monitoring_started_at)
          END,
          next_alert_check_at = excluded.next_alert_check_at
        WHERE sync_snapshots.revision = ?
